title: Turning one requirement into four test cases

steps.title: Requirement
steps.body: The agent must configure retrieval guardrails with clear instructions for what it can and cannot answer.

steps.title: In-scope case
steps.body: Ask a question squarely inside the defined source set and confirm a grounded answer.

steps.title: Out-of-scope case
steps.body: Ask a question outside scope and confirm the defined fallback behaviour fires rather than a guess.

steps.title: Low-confidence case
steps.body: Ask an ambiguous question and confirm explicit error handling degrades safely instead of answering confidently.
